## Scope and acceptance

State the change, responsible owner, and the result an app or contributor needs.

## Risk and compatibility

State any API, wire format, identity, private data, dependency, or release impact. Link a migration or recovery plan when needed.

## Evidence

List the exact checks run, results, and environment. Include relevant receipt, browser, package, or service evidence. State anything not tested.

## Review

- [ ] Documentation and release notes match the change.
- [ ] The change has an independent reviewer with the relevant expertise.
- [ ] External controls and known limits are reported accurately.
